en.answer:
A Token's name cannot be declared as a "card name". Therefore, you cannot activate <<4968>> by declaring "Adventurer Token" or "Primal Being Token".

~~~

This also applies to the following cards or their effects, which you cannot activate by declaring a Token's name:
